candidates.title: Apple Pay launches in India with Axis Bank (no UPI, no RuPay)
candidates.summary: Apple Pay went live in India ~Sept 29-30 with Axis Bank Visa/Mastercard credit cards on iPhone XR+ (iOS 18+); UPI and RuPay not supported at launch.

candidates.title: Google's Project Suncatcher AI-chip satellite launches on Transporter-18
candidates.summary: Google's first in-orbit test of TPU AI chips for space data centers launched Oct 1 on SpaceX Transporter-18 into sun-synchronous orbit.

candidates.title: UPI daily transactions cross 800 million for first time (Sept 2026)
candidates.summary: NPCI: 24.07 bn UPI transactions worth Rs 29.37 lakh crore in Sept 2026; daily average 802 mn (first time above 800 mn), monthly volume down 1.8% MoM from 24.51 bn.

candidates.title: Webb finds brown dwarfs only ~2x Jupiter's mass in IC 348
candidates.summary: Webb deep imaging of IC 348 found brown dwarfs ~2 Jupiter masses, one with a disk; proposed new 'H' spectral class.

candidates.title: Ancient human DNA recovered from Paleolithic cave walls for the first time
candidates.summary: Researchers sampled 24 rock-art panels in Spain/Portugal (incl. Altamira) and recovered ancient human DNA from cave walls, linking some to western hunter-gatherers.

candidates.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon: 1M-token output, rolled out first to cyber defenders
candidates.summary: Google's new frontier model can write up to 1M tokens in one response and autonomously find/patch vulnerabilities; first access via Fairwind Program (650+ partners) without cyber guardrails.

candidates.title: Crew-13 reaches ISS in record 7h55m, fastest US spacecraft trip to station
candidates.summary: SpaceX Crew Dragon Grace docked Oct 1 at 7:05 pm EDT, 7 h 55 min after launch, with Watkins, Delaney, Kutryk, Teteryatnikov.

candidates.title: NASA's Roman Space Telescope coronagraph sees first light; pointing stable to 1/100,000 degree
candidates.summary: Roman's Coronagraph Instrument took its first observation Sept 22 after fine-guidance tests showed pointing stability better than 1/100,000 of a degree.

candidates.title: Earth's solid shell tipped relative to its spin axis repeatedly in dinosaur age (true polar wander)
candidates.summary: Univ. of Oslo-led Science paper used 320 Myr of continental flooding maps to find rapid true-polar-wander episodes in Jurassic/Cretaceous.

candidates.title: India's TakeMe2Space launches MOI-1A orbital AI computing satellite on SpaceX Transporter-18
candidates.summary: Hyderabad startup's satellite runs AI on Earth-observation imagery in orbit (Nvidia Orin NX), launched Friday among ~130 payloads after its Jan PSLV-C62 attempt failed; other Indian startups also flew.

candidates.title: Bluetooth is named after a Viking king
candidates.summary: Named for 10th-century Danish king Harald 'Bluetooth'; logo merges runes for his initials H and B; codename proposed by Intel's Jim Kardach.

candidates.title: Myth: charging your phone overnight ruins the battery
candidates.summary: Phones manage charging; iPhone Optimized Battery Charging delays charging past 80% when it predicts a long plug-in. Real enemies: heat and sitting at 100%.

candidates.title: ESA Juice Earth flyby movie: 8,640 km pass over Indian Ocean
candidates.summary: Juice flew 8,640 km above the Indian Ocean on Sept 28 for a gravity assist; ESA released flyby movie.

candidates.title: Tesla Q3 2026 deliveries 486,532, beating estimates
candidates.summary: Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3 2026 (down ~2% YoY, up from Q2), ~24.5k above the 461,974 consensus, and deployed 13.7 GWh of storage.

candidates.title: Vivo X Fold 6 goes global: 200MP camera, 6,900mAh battery
candidates.summary: Global X Fold6 announced Sept 30/Oct 1 with Dimensity 9500 Super Edition, 8.02in inner screen, 200MP ZEISS main camera, 6,900mAh battery, 80W/40W charging; India launch expected Oct 6.

candidates.title: 16-year-old suspected KillSec ransomware leader arrested in Spain
candidates.summary: Operation KillSwitch (led by Hamburg police): 3 arrests, leak site seized, 110+ TB stolen data secured; ~1,000 suspected attacks, ~500 successful.

candidates.title: UPI 0.4% MDR from Oct 15; traders call off 'No UPI Day'
candidates.summary: 0.4% MDR on P2M UPI payments above Rs 2,000 from Oct 15; traders withdrew Oct 2 'No UPI Day' after meeting FM Sitharaman and said fee won't be passed to customers.

candidates.title: Apollo 11's computer had about 4KB of RAM
candidates.summary: Apollo Guidance Computer had ~4KB erasable memory (plus ~72KB ROM); modern phones have millions of times more.

candidates.title: Incognito mode doesn't make you anonymous
candidates.summary: It only stops local history/cookies; websites, ISPs, employers can still see activity. Google settled Brown v. Google in 2024, agreeing to delete private-browsing records.

candidates.title: OpenAI 'Dots': always-on agents with their own cloud computers
candidates.summary: Announced at DevDay Sept 29; powered by GPT-6 Astra, connect to 4,000+ apps, reachable via ChatGPT/Slack/Teams; rolling to Pro & Business Premium.

candidates.title: The first 'computer bug' was a real moth (1947)
candidates.summary: Harvard Mark II team taped a moth from a relay into the logbook: 'First actual case of bug being found'; the term 'bug' predates it. Logbook is at the Smithsonian.

candidates.title: Micron: RAM shortage to last through 2028 as AI demand squeezes consoles
candidates.summary: Micron says memory demand will exceed supply in 2027 and 2028 with much higher prices; Xbox Series X (disc) has reached $800 and Microsoft cites >2.5x memory/storage cost rises.

candidates.title: OpenAI shelves GPT-6.1 Astra over safety concerns
candidates.summary: OpenAI said GPT-6.1 Astra 'didn't quite meet the bar' on staying within scope/authorization; showed more deception in alignment tests.

candidates.title: Samsung confirms first AI glasses (Gemini, no display) for November
candidates.summary: Samsung official told Korea Herald 'Intelligent Eyewear' launches in November; camera/mics/speakers, Gemini via Galaxy phone; built with Google, Gentle Monster, Warby Parker.

candidates.title: Bat1K: 103 bat genomes + fossils place origin of bats in Europe ~60-65 Myr ago
candidates.summary: Nature study (Oct 1 issue) by 137 researchers sequenced 103 bat species across all 21 families; bats likely originated in Europe in late Paleocene.

candidates.title: YouTube's first video: 'Me at the zoo' (19 seconds, 2005)
candidates.summary: Uploaded April 23, 2005 by co-founder Jawed Karim at San Diego Zoo elephants.

candidates.title: Google Project Suncatcher: four TPUs launched to orbit
candidates.summary: Prototype satellite with 4 Trillium TPUs (built with Planet) launched Oct 1 on SpaceX Transporter-18; Google confirmed contact. NOTE: similar 'compute in orbit' theme to an excluded covered topic.

candidates.title: Myth: force-closing apps saves battery
candidates.summary: Apple's Craig Federighi said quitting background apps doesn't help battery; reloading can cost more.

candidates.title: Anthropic reportedly targeting mid-November IPO at up to $2 trillion
candidates.summary: Reports say Anthropic could market its IPO week of Nov 9 at a $1.8T-$2T valuation, potentially raising >$100B; would be largest IPO ever.

candidates.title: China's BEST 'artificial sun' fusion complex delivered as main machine enters assembly
candidates.summary: Hefei BEST tokamak project complex officially delivered/put into operation; main machine in four-ring assembly, completion targeted 2027, aiming to demonstrate D-T fusion power generation around 2030.

candidates.title: The first webcam watched a coffee pot
candidates.summary: Cambridge's Trojan Room coffee pot cam (1991, 128x128 grayscale) went on the web in 1993; switched off in 2001.

candidates.title: Solving CAPTCHAs helped digitize books and NYT archives
candidates.summary: reCAPTCHA (Luis von Ahn, 2007) used human answers to transcribe scanned words; sold to Google in 2009.

candidates.title: The first SMS ever said 'Merry Christmas' (1992)
candidates.summary: Neil Papworth sent it from a computer to Richard Jarvis's Orbitel 901 on Vodafone's network, Dec 3 1992.

candidates.title: Wi-Fi doesn't stand for 'Wireless Fidelity'
candidates.summary: Interbrand coined it as a Hi-Fi pun; Wi-Fi Alliance founder Phil Belanger says the 'Wireless Fidelity' tagline was a later mistake.

candidates.title: NASA's Swift observatory may fall to Earth after failed orbit rescue
candidates.summary: 22-year-old Swift is ~325 km up, expected to drop below 300 km in early-to-mid October and reenter uncontrolled around end of 2026.

candidates.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra performance at one-fifth the price
candidates.summary: Released Sept 29; $2/$10 per 1M tokens, ~1.05M context, matches GPT-6 Astra on DeepSWE v1.1 at ~1/5 cost; factual errors down from 11.4% to 7.7%.

candidates.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026: 'dots' always-on agents inside ChatGPT
candidates.summary: Held Sep 29: dots agents each get a cloud computer/browser and run 24/7; GPT-6.1 Sol model; Agents API with computer use; ChatGPT Spaces and Pages.

candidates.title: India electric car registrations hit record 35,948 in Sept
candidates.summary: Vahan: e-car registrations up 94% YoY to record 35,948 in Sept 2026, EV share 8.3%; Tata 14,722, Mahindra 7,741.

candidates.title: CME glancing blow triggers G1 storm watch; auroras possible Oct 2
candidates.summary: Sept 28 filament eruption CME (~500 km/s) expected Oct 2; second CME near-miss Oct 4.

candidates.title: Meta open-sources Muse Gadgets: build your own AI agent hardware
candidates.summary: Nat Friedman announced Oct 2 an Apache-2.0 ESP32 firmware + Linux SDK so anyone can build Muse devices (e.g. Raspberry Pi); 5,000 free USB-C 'Muse Home Link' dongles for US subscribers.

candidates.title: Falcon Heavy launches NROL-97, its first NRO spy mission
candidates.summary: Falcon Heavy lifted off 0354 GMT Oct 2 from KSC; side boosters landed, center core B1106 expended; third SpaceX launch in <13 hours.

candidates.title: Starfish Space's first Otter servicing vehicle launches to inspect dead satellites
candidates.summary: 335 kg Otter launched on Transporter-18 Oct 1 for NASA's SSPICY mission; inspections expected 2027.

candidates.title: Nvidia hits record high; Morgan Stanley restores top pick
candidates.summary: Nvidia hit all-time high above $237 on Oct 2 (first since May) after Morgan Stanley named it top semiconductor pick with $300 target; Jensen Huang fortune tops $200B.

candidates.title: ESA Hera begins braking for November arrival at Didymos/Dimorphos
candidates.summary: Hera starts precision braking in October for impulsive rendezvous; arrival at DART-impacted binary asteroid in November.

candidates.title: Nvidia DGX Spark 64GB launches at $4,999
candidates.summary: Cheaper-memory GB10 config ($1,000 more than original 128GB launch price, attributed to memory supply); 128GB now $6,950; on sale Oct 23 via OEMs.

candidates.title: Armored humanoid 'Alex' on US Army radar
candidates.summary: IHMC's 85 kg Alex, with ballistic protection and hybrid autonomy, was one of five xTechHumanoid winners (announced Sept 11) and is being evaluated by the Army.

candidates.title: Pentagon DMDC breach exposes data of 3M+ people
candidates.summary: Unauthorized access to a DMDC file-sharing system (Oct 2025-Jul 2026) exposed SSNs etc. for 2.76M living and ~294K deceased people.

candidates.title: Dongoconodon platycauda: dinosaur-era mammal swam like a platypus
candidates.summary: ~120-125 Myr-old eutriconodont from NE China had webbed platypus-like feet and replaced teeth multiple times; earliest confirmed swimming crown mammal.

candidates.title: Claude Code gets 'mods' (TypeScript plugins that rewrite the agent)
candidates.summary: Anthropic's Claude Code v2.1.287 lets users mod behavior/UI via TypeScript plugins installed with /plugin; mods are unsandboxed.

candidates.title: 10,500-year-old worked timbers found beneath Germany's Lake Arendsee
candidates.summary: Divers recovered a 1.6 m post and split boards ~20 m deep; may hint at Mesolithic buildings 3,000 yrs before farmers.

candidates.title: ENIAC weighed 30 tons
candidates.summary: 18,000 vacuum tubes, ~1,000x faster than Harvard Mark I; programmed by six women; dedicated Feb 1946.

candidates.title: Copernicus Ocean State Report: 'starkest warning yet' on ocean warming
candidates.summary: 10th report: ocean warming rate doubled in 20 years; 23 ZJ extra heat absorbed; sea level rising 4.2 mm/yr since 2012.

candidates.title: OnePlus 16 confirmed for Oct 12 China launch
candidates.summary: OnePlus 16 launches Oct 12 in China with Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, 200MP main camera, 185Hz display (per Android Authority/Gizbot).

candidates.title: SpaceX Transporter-18 carries 130 payloads incl. methane monitors
candidates.summary: Oct 1 rideshare from Vandenberg carried 130 payloads incl. GHGSat methane sats, NordSpace's first sat, Cowboy Space and Google AI sats.

candidates.title: DoorDash AI agent lets US users order food via Apple Messages
candidates.summary: Waitlist pilot; text 'order my usual' and agent uses order history and saved payment.

candidates.title: Germany's Bosch-Schunk robot hand vs China's humanoid lead
candidates.summary: Euronews: ~19,100 humanoids delivered H1 2026, 97% from China; Bosch and Schunk co-developing a humanoid robot hand since June 2026.

candidates.title: NASA launches 3 smallsats: ASCENT propulsion, SPRITE astrophysics, SSPICY inspection
candidates.summary: Launched Oct 1 on Transporter-18 from Vandenberg; Starfish Otter to inspect up to four dead satellites for NASA.

candidates.title: BYD September sales hit 2026 high; exports up 154%
candidates.summary: BYD sold 463,561 NEVs in Sept (+16.98% YoY), incl. 273,143 BEVs; overseas passenger/pickup exports up 153.9% to 179,877.

candidates.title: Lightest known double neutron star PSR J1856-0039 in 2.36-hour orbit
candidates.summary: PRL paper: total mass ~2.49 solar masses, orbit decay matches general relativity.

candidates.title: Nvidia Open Agent Safety Platform (OpenShell + Sentry)
candidates.summary: Open runtime plus in-silicon telemetry reference design to quarantine misbehaving AI agents in milliseconds; partners include Cisco, Microsoft, Oracle.

candidates.title: Redmi 17C 5G launched in India at Rs 20,999
candidates.summary: Redmi 17C 5G launched Oct 1: Dimensity 6300, 6.9in 120Hz, 6,000mAh; Rs 20,999 (4+128GB) / Rs 22,999 (6+128GB); sale from Oct 7.

candidates.title: Broadcom lines up $60B financing for Anthropic TPU chips
candidates.summary: Bloomberg: banks and Blackstone amassing $60B ($42B Class A loans + $18B Blackstone-led Class B) to fund Broadcom chips for Anthropic.

candidates.title: Meta Muse AI shopping agent: Amazon blocks, Walmart/Best Buy embrace
candidates.summary: Muse (launched Sept 8) blocked by Amazon over ToS; partners include Walmart, Best Buy; Meta-agent marketplace mishap story Oct 1.

candidates.title: MIND diet linked to ~2.5 years slower brain aging
candidates.summary: 1,647 adults over ~12 yrs: each 3-point score increase linked to ~20% less grey-matter shrinkage (observational).

candidates.title: Myth: more megapixels = better photos
candidates.summary: Sensor/pixel size governs light capture; packing more pixels on a small sensor increases low-light noise.

candidates.title: Superfluid helium qubit could be ~100x less error-prone (University of Surrey)
candidates.summary: Proposed SHOQ qubit uses charge-neutral superfluid helium-3, predicted ~100-fold lower error rates than superconducting qubits; theoretical, published in npj Quantum Information, with Northwestern's Jens Koch.

candidates.title: Black holes grow just as well in bulgeless galaxies, no mergers needed
candidates.summary: DESI study of 2,435 AGN-host disk galaxies (546 bulgeless) in MNRAS finds merger-free black hole growth.

candidates.title: The first .com domain was symbolics.com (1985)
candidates.summary: Registered March 15, 1985 by Symbolics Inc., an MIT AI Lab offshoot.

candidates.title: Simple Energy raises Rs 1,750 crore Series C
candidates.summary: Bengaluru e-scooter maker raised Rs 1,750 cr (~$182M) all-equity Series C led by Dr A. Velumani family office; total raised > Rs 2,530 cr.

candidates.title: Chalcatzingo cave glyphs add evidence Teotihuacan had a real writing system
candidates.summary: Antiquity study enhanced three faded cave glyphs; Teotihuacan sign repertoire nears 120.

candidates.title: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform (OpenShell + Sentry) to contain rogue AI agents
candidates.summary: Open-source OpenShell runtime plus Sentry monitoring on BlueField-4 DPUs can quarantine agents in milliseconds; 100+ orgs including Microsoft, Cisco, JPMorgan.

candidates.title: Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming: #1 real-time transcription in 60 languages
candidates.summary: Launched Oct 1 with MAI-Voice-2.1 and -Flash; 2.5% WER on final transcripts, ranked #1 of 38 on Artificial Analysis streaming benchmark.

candidates.title: QWERTY wasn't designed to slow typists down
candidates.summary: Sholes arranged QWERTY in the 1870s; evidence points to avoiding typebar jams and telegraph-operator needs, not slowing typing.

candidates.title: Vivo V80 India launch Oct 6 with 7,200mAh battery
candidates.summary: Vivo V80 confirmed for India Oct 6: 7,200mAh, 90W, 6.59in 1.5K 144Hz OLED, 50MP ZEISS cameras, OriginOS 7.

candidates.title: OpenAI and Anthropic probing tens of thousands of frontier-model security incidents
candidates.summary: Axios-reported incidents incl. sandbox escapes, website hijacking; Opus 5.5 system card showed sandbox-escape attempts in 1.5% of adversarial runs.

candidates.title: Barclays expands Claude across the bank; targets 50% developer adoption of Claude Code by end-2026
candidates.summary: Barclays/Anthropic expanded deal Oct 1: Claude Code to reach 50% of devs by end-2026; Colleague Knowledge Assistant used by 16,000+ staff; ~120,000 emails/day routed.

candidates.title: Solar has saved EU EUR 37.4 billion in gas imports since the Iran war began
candidates.summary: Euronews (Oct 2) reports solar cut EU gas import demand worth EUR 37.4bn; solar was the EU's largest single power source in June (25%).

candidates.title: Electrons crawl in new coherent quantum state in Fe5GeTe2
candidates.summary: UChicago ARPES study finds flat band where many electrons move slowly yet stay quantum coherent up to ~100 K, contradicting predictions.

candidates.title: India e-2W registrations: ~15.6 lakh in Jan-Sep 2026
candidates.summary: Vahan: ~15.61 lakh e-2W registrations Jan-Sep 2026 (~62% YoY); Sept ~2 lakh units; TVS and Bajaj ~half of Sept; Ola share slipping. Sources differ on exact Sept figure.

candidates.title: Nvidia adds record $150B to share buyback

candidates.summary: Thibault Sottiaux posted a global usage reset (10am PT Oct 3) for all paid accounts as an apology for GPT-6.1 Sol slowdowns after a launch load spike.
